claim: WP1-CAT-v1 qualifies deterministic native generation of two bounded Earth-Moon planar Lyapunov family segments in normalized rotating-frame CR3BP: L1 amplitudes 0.001 through 0.080 and L2 amplitudes 0.001 through 0.040, where amplitude is x_L-x on the y=z=vx=vz=0, vy>0 canonical section. Seeds are derived only from the analytic collinear center mode, sequential members are differentially corrected without external orbit seeds, accepted members satisfy frozen closure and symmetry gates, phase-invariant (Jacobi constant, period) deduplication is applied, Floquet stability labels are attached, and recovery is evaluated against disjoint pinned NASA/JPL development, calibration, and holdout rows.
evidence_boundary: This campaign does not qualify Halo, vertical, resonant, bifurcating, collision, or full three-body families; other mass systems; pseudo-arclength traversal through folds; completeness even inside the declared windows; discovery of disconnected families; long-horizon stability; catalogue uniqueness outside the canonical section; portable throughput guarantees; or a production catalogue of all CR3BP or three-body periodic orbits. External recovery establishes agreement with a sampled pinned JPL corpus only. Throughput is reported as host-specific evidence and is not a gate.

external_source.name: NASA/JPL Three-Body Periodic Orbits API
external_source.role: evaluation-only; forbidden as a generation, continuation, or correction input

sampling.selection: SHA-256 rank within each L-point after analytic amplitude-window filtering
sampling.partition_policy: development first, then calibration, then holdout in deterministic salted rank; no row occurs in more than one split

generation.seed: analytic planar center mode at the exact collinear equilibrium

stability.method: analytic CR3BP variational equations over one corrected period

external_recovery.matching: nearest same-L-point native x on the frozen canonical section; stability is not used to select a match
